blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateOrderExchanges` method. This belongs to the Order Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method updates existing order exchanges.

types.name: data
types.description:
The filters specifying which exchanges to update,
and the data to update in them.

children.name: selector
children.description: The filters specifying which exchanges to update.

children.name: id
children.description: The exchange's ID.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The associated order's ID.

children.name: order
children.description: The associated order.

children.name: order_version
children.description: The version of the order when the exchange is applied.

children.name: display_id
children.description: The exchange's display ID.

children.name: additional_items
children.description: The items to be sent to the customer.

children.name: no_notification
children.description:
Whether the customer should receive notifications related
to updates on the exchange.

children.name: difference_due
children.description:
The difference due of the order exchange.

- If less than `0`, the merchant owes the customer this amount.
- If greater than `0`, the customer owes the merchange this amount.
- If equal to `0`, no payment is required by either sides.

children.name: raw_difference_due
children.description:
The raw difference due of the order exchange.

- If less than `0`, the merchant owes the customer this amount.
- If greater than `0`, the customer owes the merchange this amount.
- If equal to `0`, no payment is required by either sides.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Whether the variants that are out of stock can be added to the exchange.

children.name: return
children.description: The associated return.

children.name: return_id
children.description: The associated return's ID.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The id of the user that created the order exchange

children.name: shipping_methods
children.description: The shipping methods used to send the additional items.

children.name: transactions
children.description: The exchange's transactions if additional payment is required.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The creation date of the exchange.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The update date of the exchange.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The deletion date of the exchange.

children.name: canceled_at
children.description: The cancelation date of the exchange.

- If less than `0`, the merchant owes the customer this amount.

children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

children.name: idempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the current workflow execution.

children.name: parentStepIdempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.

children.name: preventReleaseEvents
children.description: preventReleaseEvents

children.name: isCancelling
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether the current workflow execution is being cancelled.

children.name: cancelingFromParentStep
children.description:
Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.
